name: mail-bridge-private
description: Private multi-account IMAP reading, explicit SMTP drafts/sending, and optional new-mail events through the owner-hosted Mail Bridge.

interface.longDescription: Read selected QQ/ZJU mailbox accounts through an owner-hosted HTTP MCP server. Preview a sender-specific draft and send only after explicit approval. SMTP and events start disabled; no mailbox credentials are stored in this plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my configured mailbox accounts and their configuration status.
